unresolved_gaps: No cited evidence links measured reliability problems to customer retention and full operating economics strongly enough to establish the claimed causal impossibility.
Inference prices do not reveal providers' actual service costs.
Financial improvements and continuing losses do not by themselves establish durable sustainability or inherent unsustainability.
The claim supplies no accounting basis for a decisive financial comparison.
